The '''Imperial Coalition''', also known as '''Palpatine's alliance''', was an alliance between the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Ruling Circle]] and remaining [[Fleet Commander/Legends|fleet commanders]] who remained [[New Order/Legends|loyal]] to the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] which had largely collapsed following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Forming in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. While the Coalition held the former [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in addition to vital Imperial [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Galactic Core]] as well as beyond [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Imperial power remained dispersed. Thrawn's unfinished victory in his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] fueled conflict between each side, leading to the eruption of a full-scale [[Imperial Civil War]] within [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that splintered Imperial forces until the [[Operation Shadow Hand|return]] of Palpatine along with his [[Dark Empire]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].

==History==
===United for survival===
[[File:Inner_circle.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The fallen Emperor's Advisors and Ruling Circle formed the Coalition with fleet commanders to hold on to power.]]
After his resurrection on Byss, Palpatine began to recruit Deep Core warlords such as [[Blitzer Harrsk]], [[Treuten Teradoc]] and [[Sander Delvardus]] to his cause. The surviving members of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Ruling Circle]] joined after, bringing the Moffs and the fleet commanders who had control of the former Empire proper to form the<ref name="TEA" /> Imperial Coalition.<ref name="DES" /> Most of these disparate factions hated each other, and only agreed to form the Coalition for fear of not getting a share of the spoils.<ref name="TEA" /> The Ruling Circle was populated by the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] with his [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]], and was planned by Palpatine to eventually replace the system of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and [[Governor/Legends|governors]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to establish a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] theocracy. Meanwhile, the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanders]] held power over the remnants of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], wielding [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and their accompaniments as forces of destruction.<ref name="DES" /> Many members of the Coalition did not know Palpatine's hand behind the unification, including the<ref name="TEA" /> mainline Imperial forces under [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who also joined the Coaliton.<ref name="NEC" /> During this time, the New Republic received many strange reports about Imperial personnel and warships that had disappeared, including [[Inos Fonada]] and his armada, designers and schematics from the fortress world of [[Kelada/Legends|Kelada]], and Admiral [[Feyet Kiez]] and his [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]''. In addition, reports came that warlords Harrsk, Teradoc, Delvardus and [[Foga Brill/Legends|Foga Brill]] stopped scheming and skirmishing. The [[New Republic Intelligence]] initially believed that one warlord had taken control. In reality, the forces had joined together under Palpatine's banner and were preparing to make a devastating strike on the galaxy. However, these reports where initially dismissed during the chaos that ensued following [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] death, and the New Republic sent it's forces back to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In addition to maintaining a hold over the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Galactic Core]] as well as many regions of high industry beyond the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the Coalition assaulted the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after Thrawn's defeat at [[Bilbringi]],<ref name="DES" /> in a stunningly violent campaign, which caught the New Republic by surprise.<ref name="NEC" /> Three massive task forces emerged from the Deep Core, including four [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]], including the ''Whelm'', five [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|Mandator IIIs]], and three [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> With the Republic's forces in disarray in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], the Coalition was able to capture several key [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the Core within days.<ref name="NEC" /> The New Republic tried to halt the advance at [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]], but a fleet of raiders sent to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], surprised them.<ref name="TEGTW" /> The Coalition captured [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="DES" /> in a [[Second Battle of Coruscant|battle]] led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Alix Balan]]<ref name="TEGTW" /> in 10 ABY.<ref name="TEA" /> However, the former [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was not used as the prime base of operations.<ref name="DES" />

===A fragile alliance===
[[File:XR-85_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|right|240px|The Coalition was shattered by greed as tension between various factions erupted in a destructive civil war.]]
Nevertheless, [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisors]] such as [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]] suggested that they convene in the old [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate building]] on Coruscant so that a new ruler be elected from amongst themselves, and that they establish themselves in a new Empire there to oversee the newly-crowned ruler's decisions. Although Moffs and governors opposed and brought down the plan, the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] leadership was uneasy with what they saw as [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] plotting in making decisions based on political convenience. Individual ministers, munitions tycoons, and functionaries immediately returned to their plotting, with the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] doing likewise, exercising their power by staging show trials in their resentment of the Military's independence.<ref name="DES" />

The Military itself, both [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]], gave themselves the power to appoint the new Emperor. The navy demanded the right to appoint a new Grand Admiral from their chain of command to resume the [[Thrawn campaign]] in addition, with the army wanting their say in the matter as well. The bureaucracy dismissed the military in response to the navy, claiming that Thrawn failed, and turned to regional militias and the [[CompForce/Legends|CompForces]] instead.<ref name="DES" />

===Shattered===
Violence ultimately erupted after [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of [[Politics/Legends|political]] maneuvering within the Imperial Coalition as Thrawn's unfinished victory fueled internal conflict to the extent of a full-scale [[Imperial Civil War]]. The Emperor's Ruling Circle came to blows against the military, instigating brutal fights of attrition involving a dozen loyalties where navy fought navy, orders of sieges and [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardments]] were issued, [[Terror Trooper|terror troops]] destroyed planetary defense equipment, and anarchy reigned throughout cities. The presence of counter-insurgents and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]] was rampant on the former Imperial capital.<ref name="DES" />

The war rendered Coruscant a disaster world,<ref name="DES" /> and although Palpatine [[Operation Shadow Hand|returned]] with the [[Dark Empire]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Emperor and his dark forces fell within a [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC" /> once again leaving Imperial forces to be consumed by greed. Despite this, New Republic planners had high hopes of remaking and rededicating Coruscant to the ideals of civilization as Imperials desperately clung onto what remained of their holdings.<ref name="DES" />
